title: Building a Sustainable Educator Workforce for the Next Phase of Education Reform
what_it_is: Building a Sustainable Educator Workforce for the Next Phase of Education Reform

sections.label: Teacher morale as national issue
sections.summary: Teacher morale, growth and retention must be treated as a strategic national issue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: Their morale, growth and retention must be treated as a strategic national issue.

sections.label: Educator sustainability indicators request
sections.summary: Some teachers supported leaders who stopped programmes and simplified work, so MOE is asked to define and publish educator-sustainability indicators with STU and education unions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: In our dialogues, some teachers supported leaders who stopped programmes and simplified their work.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: I, therefore, ask MOE to work with STU and the relevant education unions to define and publish a set of educator-sustainability indicators, tracked alongside student outcomes.

sections.label: Smaller classes and sustainability indicators
sections.summary: Smaller classes could give teachers more scope for individual attention, so MOE is asked to publish educator sustainability indicators with education unions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: Smaller classes could give teachers more scope and opportunity to provide individual attention, build relationships and respond to the different learning needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: This is why I ask MOE to work with our education unions to publish educator sustainability indicators alongside student outcomes, that covers workload, morale, professional growth and retention.

sections.label: CTCs formed
sections.summary: As NTUC reported in August, more than 3,800 CTCs had been formed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: As NTUC reported in August, more than 3,800 CTCs had been formed.

sections.label: ESU survey and MOE support
sections.summary: An ESU survey of 1,312 respondents found concerns on administrative load, work-life balance and inclusion, so MOE is asked to work with MSF, ECDA and ESU.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: Her account connects with Education Services Union's (ESU's) survey of 1,312 respondents: 49% were concerned with administrative load and the same proportion with work-life balance; 65% identified inclusion and diverse learning needs as an additional training priority.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: These findings provide agencies, employers and ESU with a basis for focused action.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: So, I ask MOE to work with closely with Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) and ESU on documentation demands, staffing and relief covers, predictable working arrangements, protected breaks and practical well-being support.

sections.label: Dedicated programme and events post
sections.summary: MOE is asked to add a dedicated programme and events execution post in every school establishment over and above current plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In its response to 2022 Adjournment Motion on educators, MOE pointed to school administrative teams, funding for vendors to assist with events, enrichment activities and camps.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Our proposal is to strengthen the capacity and importantly, to ensure it results in meaningful transfer of work away from teachers.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: I therefore ask MOE to add a dedicated programme and events' execution post in every school establishment over and above current plans.

sections.label: Multi-year plan for workforce
sections.summary: MOE should set out a multi-year plan to expand and professionalise the workforce, with targets and fair contracts.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: MOE should set out a multi-year plan to expand and professionalise such workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Such a plan should include set targets for qualified coaches, instructors and trained adult volunteer officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: For paid workers, additional responsibility that we ask of them must be accompanied by fair contracts, development opportunities and sustainable career pathways.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: The work we take off teachers should land with people with time, skills and support to do well.

sections.label: Attracting and retaining educators
sections.summary: Hiring more than doubled from 600 in 2023 to over 1,300 teachers in 2025, with resignation rates low and stable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: One important indicator of the health of the profession is our ability to attract and retain good educators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: We have more than doubled our hiring over the past three years, from 600 in 2023 to more than 1,300 teachers in 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: The mean annual resignation rates of teachers have also remained low and stable at around 2% to 3% over the past few decades – and this is not something that we take for granted.

sections.label: Three educator career pathways
sections.summary: MOE offers three career pathways: Teaching, School Leadership and Senior Specialist Tracks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: MOE therefore offers three career pathways – the Teaching, School Leadership and Senior Specialist Tracks – so that educators can pursue their interests and also fulfil their potential.

sections.label: Allied educators and administrative staffing
sections.summary: Allied educators doubled from about 800 to 1,600, and administrative staffing rose 50% on average per school.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: Over the past decade, we have doubled the number of allied educators in priority areas such as counselling and special educational needs, from about 800 to 1,600 across all schools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: We have also increased administrative staffing in each school by 50% on average, which frees up valuable and meaningful bandwidth for our teachers.

sections.label: Smaller classes on needs basis
sections.summary: MOE provides smaller classes on a needs-basis and will continue to review this approach.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi)
sentences.text: MOE already provides for smaller classes on a needs-basis and we will continue to review this approach.
